analysis.lean: No side or total edge; the market is about right, so the value is in a few LAL points props.
why: Our blended margin is LAL +1.6 against a -1.5 line, a gap of 0.1 points, and the blended total of 233.0 is 0.5 under the 233.5 posted.
Adjusted net ratings are close: POR +3.6 per 100 (2 games), LAL +3.3 (3 games). Both samples are tiny and both teams have faced soft schedules.
LAL's shot profile outperforms its expected value (1.149 actual vs 1.078 expected). POR's is below expected (1.068 vs 1.111), so some regression is likely both ways.
POR has 3 days of rest to LAL's 1, a small edge for POR. The projection already includes the schedule spot and Sexton's return (+0.5), so I do not count either again.
POR takes 50% of its shots from three, but LAL allows 40%, below the 42% league mark. That slightly trims POR's three-point volume.
risks: Scoot Henderson (20 min, 9.5 pts) is questionable. Sharpe is out, and POR depth is thin.
Every rating rests on 2-3 games. A single blowout, like POR's 124-83 win over PHX, distorts the raw numbers.
The line has moved 1.5 points toward POR and the total has dropped 3. The market may know something the data doesn't show.
matchups: POR defense allows centers +9% points and +22% threes per minute, which is why Kessler's points over has a matchup signal.
LAL defense allows centers -23% threes, a tough spot for POR bigs shooting from deep.
Thybulle faces his former team (from memory), which has no bearing on the numbers.
verify: Henderson's status near tip, and any change to the POR rotation.
Final lineup and minutes for LAL's starters, especially Doncic and Reaves.
Referee crew once posted, and whether the line has moved since 233.5 / -1.5.

judgment.why: Projection (+1.6 margin, 233.0 total) sits almost on the market (-1.5, 233.5), the samples are only 2-3 games, and I have no concrete edge beyond the market's fair price.

lessons: Early sample (25 graded picks). Treat every rating as tentative.
Points props are 10-3 with cushion and role signals, but 13 picks is too few to trust. Keep them as normal plays and don't scale them up yet.
Assists, rebounds and threes are 2-10 combined, and rebounds and threes are 0-3 each. Too small to be a rule; lean skip on thin-signal ones.
Picks with no signal are 1-6 and beat the close by -1.6%. Lean skip when no cushion, role, matchup or pace signal backs the pick.
The model said 57.2% overall and 63.5% on 8-12% edges, which went 2-6. Be wary of large edges; don't scale up on size alone.
